questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Rohan is comparing the capital city of Belgium with the country as a whole, and is surprised that the same community is in a majority in one place and in a minority in the other. Consider the following statements. 1. The Dutch-speaking people constitute a minority in Brussels, even though they form a majority in the country. 2. Of the total population of Belgium, 59 per cent lives in the Flemish region and speaks the Dutch language. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Thiru is reading about the island nation of Sri Lanka, a few kilometres off the southern coast of Tamil Nadu, and is checking what he knows about the Tamil groups living there. Consider the following statements. 1. Sri Lankan Tamils are the Tamil sub-group of Sri Lanka whose forefathers came from India as plantation workers during the colonial period. 2. Sri Lankan Tamils form 18 per cent of the population of Sri Lanka. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are false.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Divya asks her teacher why the Dutch-speaking and the French-speaking communities of Belgium came to be in conflict with each other during the 1950s and 1960s. Consider the following statements. 1. There were tensions between the Dutch-speaking and French-speaking communities during the 1950s and 1960s. 2. The Dutch-speaking community resented the minority French-speaking community, which was relatively rich and powerful, while the Dutch speakers got the benefit of economic development and education much later. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.
